copper mountain.note: Good morning and Happy Wednesday! No new snow to report this morning. For Thanksgiving Eve, we can expect bright, sunny skies with temps in the mid-30s at mid-mountain. Winds will be light out of the WSW, staying under 10mph throughout most of the day. Similar weather can be expected for Thanksgiving Day. Snow returns early Saturday morning with decent accumulations possible; stay tuned! Later this morning, we expect the Pitchfork lift and the Green Acres Beginner Area to open for the season, expanding our early season beginner terrain offerings. We'll have more terrain announcements to share later this week. Keep an eye on our Terrain Updates channel on Instagram to stay locked in with the latest information. We're now just a few days out from the Stifel Copper Cup, bringing the fastest men in the world to the slopes of East Village. For the full weekend event schedule visit: https://www.coppercolorado.com/copper-cup/event-experience/ . A friendly reminder that early-season conditions are still in play. Ski and ride in control, stay aware of changing surfaces and conditions, and give each other plenty of space. We've got a long season to look forward to still, and we're all in this together. Hope to see you out there!

eldora.note: 9:30 AM update – Windmill trail is now open, with Klondike expected to open sometime after noon. 🎉 -- 5:30 AM update – Good morning, skiers and riders! Welcome to the Eldora snow report for Wednesday, November 25, 2026. Eldora is officially open for alpine skiing and riding! We couldn’t be more excited to welcome you, our devoted community members, back for another great season at your backyard mountain. We are so proud of our incredibly hardworking employees, whose relentless efforts have allowed us to open this week. They deserve a HUGE round of applause. Terrain: We'll have 1,000 vertical feet of downhill riding and skiing on Hornblower and International trails, from the summit of Challenge Mountain to the base area, served by Alpenglow chairlift. No beginner terrain is available—nor is uphill access, Nordic skiing, or snowshoeing—but we're pushing to open those zones of operation as soon as conditions permit. A small Woodward Terrain Park will be available near West Wing Lodge. Please note that valid passes or tickets are required to access the hike park and the mountain in general. For more on what to expect today, read our Opening Day blog post here . NWS Weather Snapshot: Sunny, with a high near 39. West wind 11 to 16 mph, with gusts as high as 28 mph. Safety: No trees or glades will be open. Expect thin, early-season conditions on Opening Day and beyond. Be prepared to ski and ride safely and responsibly on Opening Day and all season long, bearing in mind Your Responsibility Code every time you hit the slopes. Uphill/Nordic/Snowshoe Access is currently CLOSED. For the cross-country skiers, snowshoers, and uphill skiers out there, Eldora’s Nordic trail network and uphill access routes are NOT YET OPEN. Stay tuned here for updates. Parking: We will begin charging fees for single-occupancy vehicle (SOV) arrivals sometime in December. Stay tuned here for updates on when fees will begin. Learn more about parking at Eldora here . Stay informed: Before heading to the mountain this winter, always check this page, eldora.com/conditions , for the latest information and operational updates. You can also sign up for text alerts so you never miss a beat. Text one of the following keywords to (866) 965-6224 for alerts (message and data rates may apply). ELDORA for general alerts UPHILL for uphill-specific updates NORDIC for Nordic updates. Thanks for checking the Eldora snow report. We'll see you on the hill! -- GENERAL INFORMATION Lift Hours: 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM on weekdays, 8:30 AM to 4:00 PM on weekends. Lifts currently open: Alpenglow only. Lodge Hours: 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM on weekdays, 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM on weekends. Lodges currently open: Timbers, West Wing, Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Pass & Ticket Services, Rental, and Retail: Please visit Lower Indian Peaks Lodge. Single-Occupancy Vehicle (SOV) Fees: Vehicles with two or more occupants may park for free seven days a week . Vehicles carrying only a driver will be charged $10 on weekends, during certain holiday periods, and on weekdays with 10 or more inches of new snow. Credit/debit is accepted; cash is not. High-Occupancy Vehicle (HOV) Parking: Per Boulder County requirements, the Elk Lot (nearest to Alpenglow chair) is reserved seven days a week for vehicles with three or more occupants on a first-come, first-served basis. Learn more here . EV Parking: Eldora provides 30 free ChargePoint EV charging stations. These premium parking spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are subject to the SOV policy above. To park in the EV lot, you MUST have an EV and be actively charging. If you are finished charging, please move your car to another non-EV space so others can use the chargers. Easy, Convenient RTD Bus Service from Boulder: RTD’s NB route brings you from Downtown Boulder Station straight to the Alpenglow chairlift in about 40 minutes; riders 19 and under ride RTD for FREE through RTD's Zero Fare for Youth program. For schedule and fare info, visit rtd-denver.com .

snowbird.note: Opening Day is here. Welcome back to The Bird! Resort Update: The Aerial Tram, Little Cloud, Gadzoom, Wilbere and Chickadee are scheduled to start spinning at 9 a.m., conditions permitting. Mountain Report: No new snow overnight, but it's going to be a great day to get back on the hill, with temperatures on the mountain hovering in the high 30s to low 40s, light winds and some high clouds in the forecast. I’ve heard from patrol that the mountain is skiing phenomenally well right now, and after waiting for Opening Day all summer, I can’t wait to check it out for myself. It’s still early season, so take it easy out there. Ski and ride in control, respect closures and rope lines, and remember that lift and terrain availability can change throughout the day. Tomorrow for our Tramsgiving event from 12:00p to 3:45p, bring 3 non-perishable canned goods in exchange for one free scenic ride up the tram! All proceeds will benefit the Utah Food Bank. Great cause. Great views. What could be better? Snowbird Tramsgiving That’s it from me. Have an awesome Opening Day, and I’ll see you in the lift line. Give me The Bird.
